policy_presence.summary: Official generative AI guidance and scope boundaries for University of Technology Sydney are retained in local candidate evidence pending independent presentation review.

ai_disclosure.summary: Students must acknowledge AI use in assessments; verbatim generation requires instructor direction.

coursework.summary: Course permission is determined by subject coordinator; allowed AI material still needs acknowledgement.

privacy_data_entry.summary: Library advises not to input personal, confidential, assignment or research text into GenAI.

academic_integrity.summary: Unallowed AI assignment content is considered misconduct in UTS Library guidance.

approved_tools.summary: Library lists UTS-signed-in Copilot and catalogue Research Assistant; no blanket assessment authorization.

named_ai_services.summary: Named AI services for University of Technology Sydney are retained as discovery records pending independent presentation review; service availability does not grant assessment permission.

teaching_guidance.summary: Faculty-facing subject guidance recommends discipline-sensitive AI instructions and student acknowledgement.

research_guidance.summary: Research guidance calls for confidentiality and licence checks; publication rules need further verification.

security_procurement.summary: Institutional AI system lifecycle follows a six-stage process; research is separately governed.
